scope: 0.31 official collecting regions with registered painted terrain and live blossoms. The earlier material tile and local dressing records below are version history and remain relevant to the isolated TileMap experiment.

technical_frame.camera: two-dimensional world offset; same world coordinates as field model
technical_frame.source_modification: Two new original opaque PNG material tiles copied byte-for-byte from built-in image_gen. No pixel editing, cropping, resizing or postprocessing. Runtime normal repeat maps each full tile to 512 by 512 world pixels; old painted-scene crops and mirrored/four-way sampling were removed.
technical_frame.shader_sampling: One texture(TEXTURE, world_position / 512 + flow) sample directly in fragment(). CanvasItem texture_repeat is enabled. No custom sampler helper or mirrored/cropped samples.

geometry_contract: Version 0.29 uses the same authored coast polygon for collision and core turf drawing. The accepted five-node tree is retained. Its outline is equally resampled, smoothed and shaped into varying-width banks and shallow bays. Three low-opacity 5/11/18px banks form a soft soil lip. Six uneven rooted foliage groups leave open stretches. Disabled potential resource sites and feedback are hidden.

feedback_revision: Two native passes rejected old scene-crop tiling due to visible plants, mirrors and grids. Exactly two purpose-made object-free tiles generated; normal 512px world repeat replaces all scene crop sampling. Soft banks, inside-bank roots and monotonic stems retained. User rejected rigid monotonous shores and dense initial resource sites. 0.29 replaces actual boundary and scatters potential flower positions; resource growth becomes two paid ranks.

generation_calls.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE square seamless repeating 2D game GROUND TEXTURE, opaque, flat overhead view. This is a quiet material swatch, not scenery and not an illustration of a place. Cover the entire square uniformly with very soft finely painted short grass mixed with tiny warm olive soil specks, muted yellow-green and sage-green colors with faint warm ochre undertone. Match a friendly hand-painted gouache garden game with soft sculpted brushwork and warm upper-left illumination, but no directional scene lighting or gradient across the tile. Low contrast. Texture microdetails should read as 1–12 pixels when this whole image repeats every 512 game pixels; all marks are tiny strokes and flecks, never identifiable objects. Subtle fine grass fiber strokes only. Seamlessly tileable on all four edges with even hue and density, no border, no seams, no vignetting, no central motif. Absolutely NO leaves, NO leaf clusters, NO bushes, NO flowers, NO big grass tufts, NO moss islands, NO roots, NO rocks, NO path, NO road, NO shore, NO objects, NO characters, NO text, NO UI, NO shadows of plants, NO mirrored patterns, NO checkerboard, NO large clumps. Do not draw a repeating tile preview; output only the single full-bleed square material texture. Prefer 1024x1024 output.
generation_calls.reference_role: Existing approved garden colors and soft gouache described in prompt; no images supplied

Seamlessly tileable on all four edges, seamless even value, no border or vignette. Absolutely NO shore, NO bank, NO leaves or reflected leaves, NO plant silhouettes or reflected plants, NO flowers, NO lilies, NO pads, NO rocks, NO fish, NO bubbles, NO sky/cloud reflections, NO objects, NO characters, NO letters, NO UI, NO grid, NO mirrored motifs, NO repeating tile preview. composition_20261123.scope: Pond only: four authored places at actual route nodes, shared by region_game and compact pond_tilemap; violet keeps its original composition. Warm entry soil, green bend with rooted leaves, wet material bay with taller reed heads and shore-derived groups of floating fallen leaves, low rounded shore stones at far end.
composition_20261123.sources: Original PNG bytes unchanged. Leaves reuse revision-atlas leaf; low stones reuse the existing painted stone surface at garden-terrain (700,949)-(1150,984). Broad translucent irregular ground washes and rooted reed curves are runtime presentation geometry, not new art files or colliders. Water leaves reuse the same intact leaf atlas region at a flattened presentation scale, with local water shadows and broken ripple strokes; they are decorative fallen leaves, not rooted plants, walkable islands or new resources.
composition_20261123.occlusion: Decorative actors use ground-anchor y order; only silhouettes in front of the bee fade near overlap. All potential resource positions are reserved, including future growth. Fixed-offset floating pond reeds/fountain are replaced by actual rooted composition.
composition_20261123.verification: Development native two-size fixture and anchor/state checks; purple-field non-modification and compact-map inheritance checked. First reed base at 24px margin failed the 28px root-clearance assertion and was moved to 36px. Earlier weak composition and floating inherited landmarks were revised after review. Not independent player or aesthetic acceptance. Exact revision and final image hashes belong to batch receipt.

references: real pond and violet coast geometry layout v2
painted_fields_031.tool: OpenAI built-in image_gen; 2 landscapes, 1 transparent blossom sheet, 3 localized edits to clear pocket and far-bank rooting surfaces. No third-party downloads or purchases.
painted_fields_031.sources: docs/art/collection-fields in the repository contains the two final editable opaque source paintings, the original alpha sprite sheet, guides, prompts and registration recipe. Pocket replacements were feathered into only the original generation crop pond [700,480,1100,855] / meadow [730,5,1120,355] for clearance around material roots. Far pond rocks at [1260,385,1649,640] were lowered to support live flowers near the bank.
painted_fields_031.world_contract: Single painting per region aligned to its existing collision world; height cues use exposed bank faces, light, scale and registered leaves. Bee and flowers keep native coordinates. Resource heads use trimmed calyx to meet the live stem.
painted_fields_031.acceptance: 0.30.0 map presentation rejected by Alan, who reported modest feedback improvement. 0.31.0 visual acceptance awaits his assessment.

field_ecology_032.tool: OpenAI image generation, transparent RGBA; largest connected alpha component bounds plus 3px margin; production image uniformly downsampled and saved lossless WebP. Generated PNGs retained with the review package.
